cues.text: Here's how to make, teach and share a lesson with Crafticulum.
Step one. Add your subject. Upload the specification and Crafticulum reads the units and criteria for you.
Step two. Say what you're teaching in one sentence, then press Build.
About a minute later, the whole lesson is ready, written against your criteria.
Look through each part: the starter, the teaching, the tasks and an exit quiz. You can change any of it.
Step three. Teach it. Show on board puts it up in your classroom, with timers.
Or play it as a video lesson, with Crafti reading it out and captions on screen.
Step four. Download the PowerPoint and worksheet, or make a version for learners who need more support.
Step five. Share it with a link or a QR code. Learners don't need an account.
Step six. Plan a whole unit week by week, then build every lesson in one go.
And find lessons your colleagues have already made, in the library.
Plan it, teach it, share it. Try it free at crafticulum dot co dot uk.
